title: Fresh & Smooth
description: Making Minecraft As Animated, and As Fresh As possible while remaining fully client-based (similar to Actions & Stuff pack)
author: EnderPacks
body:
Fresh & Smooth

This is a **modpack** dedicated to mods and texture packs that **makes the game more alive** and make it feel as fresh (and smooth) as possible. You can also try this modpack on Curseforge! [CF Fresh n' Smooth modpack](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/fresh-and-smooth)

What is it inspired by?

The main **inspiration** behind this project were two add-ons, **[Actions & Stuff](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp?id=61c7a786-d7ad-49e0-a710-817121cd9795)** and **[Realistic Biomes](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp?id=2249c366-c812-4fe5-a6ec-abe9d6bea6bc).** The mod pack is available for **1.21.5** and **1.21.11** **fabric**; in light of the amount of mods here, the performance is smooth, but require a capable computer, more emphasis on the Processor due to animations and particles.

credits to mods that aren't on the modrinth ecosystem:

  • Action and stuff pumpkins
  • Better Trident
  • Lumious 1.4
- [Sildur's enhanced default](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/shaders/sildurs-enhanced-default) - [Locomotion By James 1.21.10+ only](https://github.com/Trainguy9512/locomotion/tags) **IMPORTANT:** to avoid FPS drops, play this modpack on a server, **this way your processor only handle the visuals**, whilst the server handles the entities and the chunks, if you don't believe me, try running my modpack on a server vs on singleplayer. Any Reputable Service is fine, but if you'd like to support me, use **[Pinehosting](https://pine.host/enderverse)**, write my Code "ENDER" and you'll get 30% your 1st month!

Take a look at this video!

## Version 26.2 - First Stable Full Release

*Note: Work on version 26.3 is currently in progress, but being delayed while waiting for most mods to update.*

### Fixes & Improvements

Resolved an issue where visual effects was failing to load

Fixed stuttering on distant animations due to a particular performance mod.

Debloated the pack to reduce lag and improve overall performance (most notably particle ticking).

Fixed a visual inventory glitches that occurred while using workbenches.

Fixed buggy visuals for baby horses.

Fixed glitchy models for baby zombies.


### Additions

Added Do A Barrel Roll to the pack

versions.name: Fresh & Smooth 2.9.1
versions.changelog:
## Bug Fixes & Compatibility

* **Mace Fusion:** Resolved an issue where Turly Tools was overriding and breaking the fusion.
* **Creeper Textures:** Fixed a conflict where a resource pack was overriding the custom creepers from FA and Al's Creepers.
* **Armor Rendering:** Fixed armor texture issues on FA players so they display normally.
* **Spears:** Corrected rendering issues; spears now appear normally.
* **Torch Shaders:** Fixed visual bugs and rendering issues with torches.

## Visuals & Environment

* **Trident Enhancement:** They now look 3D when thrown.
* **Night Fog:** Reduced the density of the night fog to prevent it from being too overwhelming.

## Performance & Optimization

* **Stuttering:** Disabled the planes on the wakes mod and tweaked performance settings to reduce stuttering and lag.

## New Features & Animations

* **Sand Imprints:** Added sand imprint mechanics.
* **Snow Footsteps:** Added persistent footstep residue (when walking from snow to a normal block)
* **Boat Physics:** Introduced new animations for boats.

## Mod Updates

* **Joyful Motions:** Updated to the latest version and is now optional.

[Last update before 26.1.x]

* **Smooth Boot Mod:** Integrated for faster game initialization.
* **Performance Improvements:** Fixed various background bottlenecks and stuttering.
* **GUI Scaler:** Added support for flexible interface sizing.

### 🔧 Bug Fixes & Stability

- Fixed Glitched Villagers 

- Fixed Mob AI & Movement
 
- Not Enough Animations (EMF Compat): Fixed compatibility issues with Entity Model Features and FA Player pack.

- Added Eye Animations for FA Player texutre pack.


Note: 26.1.2 update coming very soon.

versions.name: F&S 2.7.2 | Punchy | Don't install if you prefer HMI!
versions.changelog:
- refined the Punchy edition

**Initial 2.7 update:**


## **New Features & Content**
* **HMI Edition Released:** A more stable version with fewer bugs.
* **Arrow In The Knee:** New content addition.
* **Packed Packs:** Integrated for easier and more efficient resource pack management.
* **Golems Refreshed:** Now included.
* **Photon Shader:** Newly added to the shader options.

## **Visuals & VFX**
* **Fox Refreshed:** FA
* **Environmental Improvements:** Shine, Snow Imprints, and Sunbathing Godrays.
* **Particle & Effect Enhancements:** Fresh XP Orbs, Better Smoke, and Enchanting Table Magic Circle.
* **Model Upgrades:** Hover Items, Just 3D Potions, and Enhanced Flower Pots.
* **Experimental VFX:** Made it optional to choose between **VFX+** or **Benigamer**. 
    > **Note:** Both are experimental and may impact performance; use at your own risk.

## **UI & Quality of Life**
* **Dynamic Crosshair:** For a more responsive combat feel.
* **Chat Heads:** Better player identification in chat.
* **Fancy Toasts | Better Advancements:** Cleaner notification system.
* **Punchy!:** Updated for technical accuracy and performance.

## **Performance & Technical Fixes**
* **Enhanced Shader Settings:** Optimized to be more vibrant, FPS-friendly, and tailored for the pack’s specific aesthetic.
* **Potassium:** Added for significantly enhanced system performance.
* **Stuttering & Optimization:**
    * Implemented fixes to reduce micro-stuttering.
    * **Note:** When playing on a server, you may notice a significant boost in performance/FPS as the server takes over world-ticking and entity logic, freeing up your local hardware resources.
* **Bug Fixes:**
    * **Handheld Torches:** Fixed rendering/glitching issues specifically for torches held in hand.
    * Resolved shield rendering issues.
    * Corrected harness glitching.

## **Removals & Compatibility**
* **3D Items (by weskerson):** Removed due to zero compatibility with **Punchy!**.
* **FA Objects:** Removed.

versions.name: 300% More FPS! | F&S 2.6.9 [Punchy!]
versions.changelog:
- Optimized the modpack to work with Punchy now

- HMI was very demanding, and also outdated, with punchy we managed a jump by roughly 300% (in my case, from 200FPS, to 700FPS)

- More Animations have been added, you'll find it hard to do something and see a dedicated animation for it

- The unused packs are all optional and risky, you can add them if you want, but you'll be risking lower FPS, and buggier gameplay, so do it at your own risk!

versions.changelog:
- Re-enabled block outlines
- Fixed few bugs
- 50% more FPS thanks to modernFix!

versions.name: Entire Re-construction! | F&S 2.6.7 [Low VFX = Less Lag]
versions.changelog:
New Features:

- Picked up a new 3d potions pack (old one wasnt entirely HMI-compatible)
- Brush & Juice for better 2D sprites
- Jiggling Lanterns on 3rd person

Bug fixes:

- Fixed elytra contrails looking dark and dim
- limited FPS At 150, which 3x'd our 1% FPS (if you disable the limit, you're risking more frequent FPS drops)
- Fixed muffled/suppressed sounds on 1.21.11
